The '''Dalchon sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] was assigned to the sector and tasked with protecting the area from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
